7df30208.text: Ner'zhul, the Lich King, knew that his time was short. Imprisoned within the Frozen Throne, he suspected that Kil'jaeden would send his agents to destroy him. The damage caused by Illidan's spell had ruptured the Frozen Throne; thus, the Lich King was losing his power daily. Desperate to save himself, he called his greatest mortal servant to his side: the death knight Prince Arthas.
7df30208.title: Civil War in the Plaguelands

8ee94608.text: With the absence of trolls in the northlands, the elves of Quel'Thalas bent their efforts towards rebuilding their glorious homeland. The victorious armies of Arathor returned home to southlands of Strom.
8ee94608.title: The Guardians of Tirisfal

dce1b1cf.text: As the politics and rivalries of the seven human nations waxed and waned, the line of Guardians kept its constant vigil against chaos. There were many Guardians over the years, but only one ever held the magical powers of Tirisfal at any given time. One of the last Guardians of the age distinguished herself as a mighty warrior against the shadow.
dce1b1cf.title: Aegwynn and the Dragon Hunt

ea53b57a.text:
The devastating Second War against the orcish horde left the Alliance of Lordaeron in a state of shock and disarray. The bloodthirsty orcs, led by the mighty warchief, Orgrim Doomhammer, not only smashed their way through the dwarf-held lands of Khaz Modan, but had razed many of Lordaeron's central provinces as well. The unrelenting orcs even succeeded in ravaging the
elves' remote kingdom of Quel'Thalas before their rampage was finally stopped.
ea53b57a.title: Aftermath of the Second War

10360|54d735c8.name: Kergul Bloodaxe
10360|54d735c8.text: $N, the Silverwing Sentinels must be crushed!  Are you ready for Warsong Gulch?

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11116|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Abeqwa
11116|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

1300|e17121fb.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|e17121fb.text: Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!

1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1346|29243a62.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|29243a62.text: You'll need more training before I can share my knowledge with you, I'm afraid.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1423|444794a8.name: Stormwind Guard
1423|444794a8.text: You can usually find Brother Wilhelm in back of the smithy trading stories with Lyria.  He's always up for teaching fellow paladins new skills.

1423|4e49ac21.name: Stormwind Guard
1423|4e49ac21.text: There are quite a few trainers available in Elwynn.  Which one are you looking for?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1684|820221cb.name: Khara Deepwater
1684|820221cb.text: There's never an end to the chores around here.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1976|8534e234.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|8534e234.text: If you are looking to become a mighty $c, there is no better teacher then Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker. He can be found in the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square.

2055|288436fb.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055|288436fb.text: The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

2238|6d472bad.name: Tog'thar
2238|6d472bad.text: Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258785|726390d0.name: High Priestess Mims
258785|726390d0.text: Surrender to the Light, $N. How can I help you serve today?

263647|fb408f08.name: Borook Gallfist
263647|fb408f08.text: Well, well... are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

268568|f87f742d.name: Roy Lewells
268568|f87f742d.text: Literacy should be celebrated and shared.

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3084|2d9bad33.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|2d9bad33.text: And to which battleground do you wish to journey?

3084|b2b0d8c6.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|b2b0d8c6.text: Kergul Bloodaxe on the Hunter Rise stands ready to help you get to Warsong Gulch.

3296|cee096e9.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|cee096e9.text: You seek Grol'dar and the Darkfire Enclave?  Find them in the underground cavern called the Cleft of Shadow.  There are two tunnels leading down into that cave, one just south of the Valley of Wisdom and the other from The Drag.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3325|031480cd.name: Mirket
3325|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

376|8fca8484.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

376|bab8ec77.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4563|031480cd.name: Kaal Soulreaper
4563|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

4563|8fca8484.name: Kaal Soulreaper
4563|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4564|db7f8bbb.name: Luther Pickman
4564|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

5484|8fca8484.name: Brother Benjamin
5484|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5484|bab8ec77.name: Brother Benjamin
5484|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5624|f669426b.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f669426b.text: Us know her good.  She Mary Edras at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5753|721fd095.name: Martha Strain
5753|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

6171|16087877.name: Duthorian Rall
6171|16087877.text:
You will be tested many times by the darkness that surrounds our lands, HAMMERDON. But to ensure you are always prepared, we will often ask tasks of you so you are at the height of your own power.

Go with the Light, and remain virtuous.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

928|08830bac.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-progress.text: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
1014-progress.title: Arugal Must Die

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

1098-complete.name: Unknown
1098-complete.text:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
1098-complete.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

11-accept.name: Deputy Rainer
11-accept.text:
Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
11-accept.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
11-complete.text: I see you've been busy!  You have our thanks, $N.
11-complete.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

1130-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
1130-accept.text:
$N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
1130-accept.title: Melor Sends Word

1195-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-accept.text:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
1195-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

123-accept.name: Unknown
123-accept.text:
This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in Elwynn Forest.

From the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.

This sounds important.  You should report it to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
123-accept.title: The Collector

123-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
123-complete.text: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for.  Thank you for the schedule.  It will help us solve this mystery.
123-complete.title: The Collector

123-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
123-progress.text:
What?!?  We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

Let me see that note you have...
123-progress.title: The Collector

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

132-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-complete.text: Bah!  I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance.  But this information is crucial.  Good work.
132-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In human lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1339-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1339-complete.text:
That's right.  I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding.  In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!
1339-complete.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

135-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
135-accept.text: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
135-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-complete.text: Edwin VanCleef... I know the name well.  To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me.  I'll need further proof before I believe this.
141-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-accept.text: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout.  $N, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.  I want you to capture him.  If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.
142-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-complete.text:
This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge.  Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.

We've had a stroke of luck while you were gone.  We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon.  He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life.  I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout.  Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
142-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-complete.text: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
143-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

147-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
147-accept.text:
If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom!  Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me.  It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...

That Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.  You should search for him there.
147-accept.title: Manhunt

147-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
147-complete.text:
You found him?  Well done, $N.  He won't be "collecting" from the Elwynn Mines again!

And this ring you found is interesting... it's a membership ring for the old Stonemason's Guild in Stormwind.  Why would a lowly thief have an artisan guild ring, and why are the Defias Thieves collecting money from our mines?

Difficult questions.  I hope one day we'll have answers.
147-complete.title: Manhunt

147-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
147-progress.text: Did you find the Collector?  Did you discover whom he's working for?
147-progress.title: Manhunt

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-complete.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-complete.text: Thank you so much, $N!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
151-complete.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-complete.name: Scout Galiaan
153-complete.text: Nice work, $r.  Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
153-complete.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

155-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
155-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
155-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

161-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
161-accept.text:
If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder.  This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here.  Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span.  I need you to make a grave and perilous journey, $N.

Travel through the Algaz Gate, follow the road through the Wetlands and seek out Stonesmirk in Dun Modr.  Heed my advice: stick to the roads and stop for nothing!
161-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

1641-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1641-complete.text:
Here in Stormwind, I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
1641-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1642-accept.name: Unknown
1642-accept.text:
In all things, a $c must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a $c as strength in battle.

Know this well, and never forget it.
1642-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1642-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1642-complete.text:
Hello again, $N. How goes your studies of the Tome of Divinity?

Then you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.

By proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
1642-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1643-accept.name: Duthorian Rall
1643-accept.text:
Your task then, $N, is to find someone here in Stormwind that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a $c of the Light.
1643-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1643-complete.name: Stephanie Turner
1643-complete.text:
Oh, hello, luv. How go your adventures? Oh, I'm so glad to hear you're doing well.

Oh, me? Thank you for asking--I'm doing well, all things considered.

The increase in tradesmen has kind of put a damper on the amount of leather and cloth people are willing to part with these days, so it's been tougher to make clothing for the children at the orphanage, but we'll manage. By "we" I mean my husband and I. He's up in Ironforge trying to seek help from the citizens there.
1643-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1644-accept.name: Stephanie Turner
1644-accept.text:
Bless their hearts, most of them have no families because of the Scourge attacks in the last decade.

My husband John collects the materials for me to make the shirts and pants for the children, but I haven't even had time to do that. I've been too focused on keeping food on their plates, and a roof over their heads.

What's that? You'd be willing to help? Oh, thank the Light, and thank you, $N.

If you could bring me some linen cloth so I can sew clothes for the kids, that would help me out so much.
1644-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1644-complete.name: Stephanie Turner
1644-complete.text:
Thank you, $N, thank you so much!

The children will be so pleased, and you've saved me so much time. I'll now be able to focus on the children's other needs, and hopefully my John will be able to return home sooner than we thought.

Thank you again, $N. I knew I could rely on the charity of others. The Light be with you.
1644-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1644-progress.name: Stephanie Turner
1644-progress.text:
I hope my John is having better luck in Ironforge. He so dislikes his trips there because it leaves the kids and me alone, but he knows it must be done. He's so kind-hearted.

Some years have been easier than others, but this one's been rougher by far. It's almost as though something in the air is signaling a huge change. Who knows though?
1644-progress.title: The Tome of Divinity

166-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-accept.text: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
166-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-complete.text:
$N, your bravery is remarkable.  The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall.  With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood.  Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

I salute you, Sir!
166-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-accept.text:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
167-accept.title: Oh Brother...

168-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-accept.text: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
168-accept.title: Collecting Memories

176-accept.name: Unknown
176-accept.text:
Wanted: Hogger

A huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.

The Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
176-accept.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
176-complete.text:
Hah!  Well done!  I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!

Here you are, $N.  And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
176-complete.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

1780-accept.name: Stephanie Turner
1780-accept.text:
I'll take these to the children this very day. Please be safe, good $c. It is not often men of your character show their faces in the city, but you've proven that the paladins here in Stormwind shall never turn their backs on those in need.

Farewell.
1780-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1780-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1780-complete.text:
You've returned so quickly, $N. And what have you accomplished in your time away from the Cathedral?

Have you helped a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Well, I'm impressed, $N, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light and values others above oneself.

Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
1780-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1781-accept.name: Duthorian Rall
1781-accept.text:
Take this, $N. It is called the Symbol of Life.

You've proven charitable and patient, and now the time has come to see if you're powerful enough to focus one of the Light's greatest gifts.

My friend Gazin returned recently from an encounter with some Defias in Elwynn near Heroes' Vigil--he barely escaped with his life. He's near the altar having his wounds healed by our priests.

Take the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May you bask in the Light's glory.
1781-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1781-complete.name: Gazin Tenorm
1781-complete.text:
*cough*

Pleasure to meet you, $c. Don't mind my wounds, the good priest here can take care of ol' Gazin this time. I won't be needing the power of that Symbol of Life you've got there... not yet anyway.

So, Duthorian sent you to speak to me, huh? Fair enough. I'll tell you exactly what befell me and my friend Henze. And with any luck, and some skill on your part, perhaps you can still help us all.
1781-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1786-accept.name: Gazin Tenorm
1786-accept.text:
Henze and I had made it to Heroes' Vigil, an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn. We'd heard the Defias had infiltrated our borders and we wanted proof to take to the king's advisors.

We caught sight of a couple of the scum going over some documents, and we attacked. Unfortunately, we were quickly overwhelmed by more of the mages.

Henze held them off for me while I escaped... the daft fool, going and being brave.

He's out there now, Henze is. Can you help us, $N?
1786-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1786-complete.name: Henze Faulk
1786-complete.text:
Thank you, brother.

Seeing you wield the Symbol of Life, may I assume Duthorian or Gazin sent you?

I fell to the Defias spell casters while Gazin and I tried to get their plans from them: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Gazin to escape, but in the end, their magics overwhelmed me.

But you were able to bring me back: the ability to use the Symbol doesn't come to just anyone, $N. It bodes well for you that you were able to empower it with your own faith.
1786-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1787-accept.name: Henze Faulk
1787-accept.text:
We'll have time to talk more about the Symbol at a later time. What's important now is to get those papers we saw the Defias going over. If we can get our hands on them, we'll be able to prove the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn and hopefully gain some insight into what their plans are.

I'm in no shape for battle as of now, $N. Do you think you're strong enough to get those papers from the Defias here on the island?

If you're able to get them, bring them back to Gazin and let him know I'm all right.
1787-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1787-complete.name: Gazin Tenorm
1787-complete.text: Wonderful! You made it, and saved Henze. The Light is with you for sure, $N!
1787-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1787-progress.name: Gazin Tenorm
1787-progress.text:
Is Henze safe, $N? Were you successful?

Between your skill with a weapon, and the power of the Light, I'd imagine Heroes' Vigil is safe from any Defias threat, but that's for the King and his advisors to say.
1787-progress.title: The Tome of Divinity

1788-accept.name: Gazin Tenorm
1788-accept.text:
I'll take the script to the King's advisors after Duthorian's taken a look at them, but in the meantime, you should go speak to Duthorian now. He'll be wanting to pat you on the back for sure!

Thank you again, $N. I hope we meet again. You're surely an ally I'm proud to call friend.
1788-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1788-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1788-complete.text:
You've done well this day, $N. You should take some pride in what you've accomplished.

Even more so, you should be proud of your abilities. Not everyone can use the power of the Symbol of Life. Calling upon the Light to bring back the dead means you're prepared for one of the $c's greatest honors: the power of resurrection.

You shall have the power to bring back fallen companions much like you did for Henze.

Be well, $N. The Light shines upon you and you should welcome it wholly.
1788-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

184-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-complete.text:
Loads of thanks, $N!  As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.

I don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.
184-complete.title: Furlbrow's Deed

184-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
184-progress.text:
You have the deed to my farm??  That's good news!  Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!

Please, let me have it.  We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
184-progress.title: Furlbrow's Deed

199-accept.name: Unknown
199-accept.text: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
199-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

199-complete.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-complete.text: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!
199-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

199-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-progress.text: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
199-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

2039-accept.name: Gnoarn
2039-accept.text:
We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, $N.
2039-accept.title: Find Bingles

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

214-accept.name: Scout Riell
214-accept.text:
It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $N.
214-accept.title: Red Silk Bandanas

214-complete.name: Scout Riell
214-complete.text: Well done, $N!  On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts.  Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
214-complete.title: Red Silk Bandanas

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

216-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
216-accept.text:
The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
216-accept.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

216-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
216-complete.text:
Well done $c, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!
216-complete.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-complete.name: Salma Saldean
22-complete.text: These are just perfect, $N!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a $c like you go hungry, did you?
22-complete.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

239-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
239-complete.text:
Marshall Dughan sent you, eh?  Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!

Our situation is, to say the least, a stressed one.  I hope you can give us a hand.
239-complete.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

250-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
250-accept.text:
Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam.  First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr!  I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat.  Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.

That's why I need you, $N.  I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam.   Investigate the area and bring back a clue.
250-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

250-complete.name: Unknown
250-complete.text: The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.
250-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

255-accept.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-accept.text:
Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.

I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.

How about you? You seem a likely sort, $c. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?
255-accept.title: Mercenaries

255-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-complete.text: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
255-complete.title: Mercenaries

256-accept.name: Unknown
256-accept.text:
By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:

Chok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.

Monetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.

Chok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
256-accept.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

256-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-complete.text:
Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...

Bloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
256-complete.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

2922-accept.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2922-accept.text:
When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot.  It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized.  Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed.  It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

But perhaps it can be salvaged.  Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
2922-accept.title: Save Techbot's Brain!

2923-accept.name: Brother Sarno
2923-accept.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot.  I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

Very sad.  But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge.  He would welcome your help.
2923-accept.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

2923-complete.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2923-complete.text: Yes it's true.  Techbot has gone rogue!  Please, can you help me?
2923-complete.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

2926-accept.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2926-accept.text:
Since the accident, all Gnoarn thinks about or talks about is cleansing Gnomeregan of the trogg infestation and finding a cure for the sickness that plagues it, $N.

Luckily, Razzle and I are close to some kind of cure - either that or the recipe for a really powerful rum. We won't know until we test! Naturally, in order to test our theory, we're going to need a few things; namely, fallout from the irradiated troggs in Gnomeregan. Fill up this phial with the green glow and bring it back!
2926-accept.title: Gnogaine

2927-accept.name: Gnoarn
2927-accept.text:
You don't think I was always bald, do you? No sir! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth.

<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>

Damn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!

Perhaps it's not too late, $N. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
2927-accept.title: The Day After

2927-complete.name: Ozzie Togglevolt
2927-complete.text:
I thought the loss of that outstanding head of hair would have been the end of him for sure, but he survived!

I was standing right next to him when he was hit by the radiation bolt. Those delightful brown locks of hair hit the floor in clumps! Clusters! The horror of it all was only compounded when Gnoarn completely freaked out! Oh yes, freaked out I say! Gnoarn touched his bald head in disbelief, the look in his eyes screamed revenge, $N! Then he turned his anger towards the troggs!

<Ozzie cringes.>
2927-complete.title: The Day After

297-accept.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-accept.text:
Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols.  But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins!  And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs.  It makes them go berserk!

Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
297-accept.title: Gathering Idols

297-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-complete.text:
You got them!  Nicely done, $N!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
297-complete.title: Gathering Idols

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
298-accept.text:
I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder!  Here's the report.  Take it to Jern Hornhelm.  He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
298-accept.title: Excavation Progress Report

2998-accept.name: Brother Wilhelm
2998-accept.text:
Greetings, brother. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential paladins, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.

If I were you, I'd head to Stormwind and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.
2998-accept.title: Tome of Divinity

2998-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
2998-complete.text:
It is beautiful here in Stormwind, is it not?

Your timing actually couldn't have been better, $N.
2998-complete.title: Tome of Divinity

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3369-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3369-complete.title: In Nightmares

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

373-accept.name: Unknown
373-accept.text:
Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.

It appears to be recently written and sealed.
373-accept.title: The Unsent Letter

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

3741-complete.name: Hilary
3741-complete.text: Thank you for finding my necklace mister $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
3741-complete.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

38-complete.name: Salma Saldean
38-complete.text: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely!  Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts.  And we're done!  For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
38-complete.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

389-complete.name: Warden Thelwater
389-complete.text:
What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?

Bazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
389-complete.title: Bazil Thredd

391-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
391-accept.text:
Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
391-accept.title: The Stockade Riots

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

399-complete.name: Baros Alexston
399-complete.text: Oh, thank you, $N! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
399-complete.title: Humble Beginnings

436-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
436-complete.text:
Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
436-complete.title: Ironband's Excavation

442-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-complete.text:
The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, $N.  Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.

Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken.  Your value to us grows.
442-complete.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

442-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-progress.text: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, $N.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
442-progress.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

451-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-complete.text:
Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard.  But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

We are on the cusp of something great here, $N.  If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
451-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

4542-accept.name: Brave Moonhorn
4542-accept.text:
Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.

Be warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... they have been acting strange toward us lately.
4542-accept.title: Message to Freewind Post

4542-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-complete.text: More bad news! These centaurs have gone too far! They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!
4542-complete.title: Message to Freewind Post

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

455-accept.name: Mountaineer Rockgar
455-accept.text:
Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the Wetlands.  And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz!  We can't let them keep their foothold here or Loch Modan will be cut off from Menethil Harbor, our port and stronghold in the Wetlands.

Break through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure!  Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Menethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.

We're counting on you, $N.  Do not fail.
455-accept.title: The Algaz Gauntlet

46-accept.name: Guard Thomas
46-accept.text:
The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
46-accept.title: Bounty on Murlocs

46-complete.name: Guard Thomas
46-complete.text:
You have the fins?  Great!  Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.

Your actions have helped realize that.
46-complete.title: Bounty on Murlocs

460-accept.name: Unknown
460-accept.text:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
460-accept.title: Resting in Pieces

460-complete.name: Unknown
460-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body.  It is good to know they did not.
460-complete.title: Resting in Pieces

461-accept.name: Unknown
461-accept.text:
I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues.  It also holds something you might find useful.  Take me there!

The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.

Take my body, but leave my boots.  They never fit me anyway...
461-accept.title: The Hidden Niche

461-complete.name: Unknown
461-complete.text:
There we are, it's open.  Leave me here.  I spent the best days of my life in this keep, and the thought of resting within its walls gives me comfort.

Be sure to close the alcove tight - I don't want those Rot Hides to find me.

Oh, and take this.  You've earned it.
461-complete.title: The Hidden Niche

461-progress.name: Unknown
461-progress.text: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
461-progress.title: The Hidden Niche

466-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
466-accept.text:
I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate.  Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!

Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.

Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining.  If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!
466-accept.title: Search for Incendicite

468-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
468-accept.text:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
468-accept.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

468-complete.name: Mountaineer Rockgar
468-complete.text:
Hello, $C!  You're here for the scouting mission, are you?  Very good!

I hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...
468-complete.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

4767-accept.name: Elu
4767-accept.text:
I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, $N.

I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
4767-accept.title: Wind Rider

4767-complete.name: Elu
4767-complete.text: Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, $C.
4767-complete.title: Wind Rider

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4821-accept.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-accept.text:
A rumor has surfaced about an alien egg here in Thousand Needles. Those that report seeing this egg have failed to even get close enough to examine it in detail. Serpents guard the egg as if it's one of their own.

I want you to seek out this alien egg and bring it to me so that I may examine it. Reports say the egg is located within a serpent den, but there are several serpent dens along the base of the cliff walls south and northeast of Freewind Post.
4821-accept.title: Alien Egg

4821-complete.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-complete.text: Yes, finally... the mysterious egg has finally been delivered to me. Now, let me take a closer look at this... What..! What is this..?
4821-complete.title: Alien Egg

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

4841-accept.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4841-accept.text: $N, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post!  Let wrath guide your hand!
4841-accept.title: Pacify the Centaur

4841-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4841-complete.text: For my gratitude, this is for you, $N.
4841-complete.title: Pacify the Centaur

4865-accept.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4865-accept.text:
If I did not see that with my own eyes I would never have believed it to be true. Vengeance has come to Thousand Needles!

<Hagar wipes his brow.>

$N, you must act quickly! Go now and seek out Motega Firemane; he is located at Whitereach Post just northwest of Freewind Post along the road. He will know what to do!
4865-accept.title: Serpent Wild

4865-complete.name: Motega Firemane
4865-complete.text: Vengeance! So, the legend of Arikara is true. Indeed, this is a problem that must be resolved immediately.
4865-complete.title: Serpent Wild

491-accept.name: Unknown
491-accept.text:
Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed.  This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it.  So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.

Here.  Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past.  I'm sure he will want it.
491-accept.title: Wand to Bethor

491-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
491-complete.text:
...what is this?  Thule had our Woven Wand?  I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!

He must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it.  And it is good that he did not use it...

This is a marvelous find.  You have my gratitude, $N, and will be rewarded.
491-complete.title: Wand to Bethor

498-complete.name: Krusk
498-complete.text:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.
498-complete.title: The Rescue

5062-accept.name: Motega Firemane
5062-accept.text:
Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.

Go now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a powerful shaman that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.

Travel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.
5062-accept.title: Sacred Fire

5064-accept.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-accept.text:
$N, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.

$N, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.
5064-accept.title: Grimtotem Spying

5064-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-complete.text:
Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.

$N, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
5064-complete.title: Grimtotem Spying

5064-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-progress.text: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?
5064-progress.title: Grimtotem Spying

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
