Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

509-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-complete.text: Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms.  At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
509-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
513-accept.text:
Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.

First I will mix them down into a fine composite.  We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!

Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, $N.
513-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

513-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-complete.text:
Apothecary Lydon sent you?  Ah, why didn't you say so!

Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite!  I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now.  And I like the way he thinks.  The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
513-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

5147-accept.name: Unknown
5147-accept.text:
Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem

Arnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.

Arnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.
5147-accept.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

515-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
515-accept.text:
A mudsnout composite?  Absolutely brilliant!  Why didn't I think of that?

Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad.  He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents.  And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
515-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

5151-accept.name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
5151-accept.text:
I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!

Here is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.

The wrecked caravan is just north of here.
5151-accept.title: Hypercapacitor Gizmo

5151-complete.name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
5151-complete.text: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...
5151-complete.title: Hypercapacitor Gizmo

528-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-complete.text: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad.  The battle goes well.
528-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-accept.text:
The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance.  The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith.  We need to shut down all supply lines.

Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan.  Slay his apprentices as well.  While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile.  The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
529-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-complete.text: Mission accomplished, $c.  And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
529-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-accept.text:
The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall.  We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting.  We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council.  Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation.  And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
532-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-complete.text: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast.  You have done well, $c.
532-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

539-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
539-accept.text:
The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under Alliance control.  Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.

Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.

The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad.  Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds.  Kill his miners as well.  That should send a clear message to the Alliance.
539-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

539-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
539-complete.text: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
539-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

541-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
541-accept.text:
Dwarves aiding the humans?  Damn those filthy little beasts.

We shall test the strength of the so-called Alliance.  We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath.  We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.

They have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok.  The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, $c.  Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
541-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

541-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
541-complete.text: Your actions on the battlefield are worthy of the highest praise.
541-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-complete.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-complete.text: Precious skulls!  So beautiful!  I owe you as promised, $N!
546-complete.title: Souvenirs of Death

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

547-accept.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-accept.text:
High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
547-accept.title: Humbert's Sword

547-complete.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-complete.text:
You found it!

Ah, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand.  Many thanks to you!
547-complete.title: Humbert's Sword

547-progress.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
547-progress.title: Humbert's Sword

549-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
549-complete.text: Excellent, $c. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
549-complete.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

550-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
550-accept.text:
Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.

Take this sealed commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.  Go with pride, $c.
550-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

550-complete.name: Varimathras
550-complete.text:
So you are the infamous $c who struck such a decisive blow against the Alliance forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills?  Word of your glorious exploits traveled quickly to the Undercity.

You have quite a future in the Dark Lady's ranks if you continue to show such leadership and expertise in battle.

While our primary threat is the Lich King's Scourge army descending from the north, the human "problem" continues to impede our battle plans.  You, however, have shown that the humans can and will fall.
550-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

550-progress.name: Varimathras
550-progress.text: What brings a $c all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?
550-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

567-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
567-complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.
567-complete.title: Dangerous!

59-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
59-complete.text:
Ah, thank you for the marker.  Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.

Luck to you, brave $c.  And may this armor serve you well.
59-complete.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6181-accept.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6181-accept.text:
Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.

Our supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?

The fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master.  He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
6181-accept.title: A Swift Message

6181-complete.name: Thor
6181-complete.text: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!
6181-complete.title: A Swift Message

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

6261-accept.name: Osric Strang
6261-accept.text:
$N, I gathered into this crate everything Lewis asked for.  Can you take it to him?

If you've already spoken to Thor in Westfall, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.

Speak with Dungar, then get this crate to Lewis as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Westfall to go without fresh equipment!
6261-accept.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-complete.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-complete.text: A crate for Westfall, eh?  Have you been to Westfall before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!
6261-complete.title: Dungar Longdrink

6261-progress.name: Dungar Longdrink
6261-progress.text: Is that sweat on your brow, lad?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
6261-progress.title: Dungar Longdrink

6281-accept.name: Thor
6281-accept.text:
For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric.  You won't get there faster any other way.

If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride.  I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
6281-accept.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-complete.name: Osric Strang
6281-complete.text:
Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.

Well thank you, $N.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
6281-complete.title: Continue to Stormwind

6281-progress.name: Osric Strang
6281-progress.text: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
6281-progress.title: Continue to Stormwind

6285-accept.name: Dungar Longdrink
6285-accept.text:
The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor.  If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.

That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.

You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
6285-accept.title: Return to Lewis

6285-complete.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-complete.text:
Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately.

Thank you, $N.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Sentinel Hill often!
6285-complete.title: Return to Lewis

6285-progress.name: Quartermaster Lewis
6285-progress.text: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
6285-progress.title: Return to Lewis

64-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind sir! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6442-accept.name: Marukai
6442-accept.text:
There is evil lurking here along the coast, $r.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
6442-accept.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6442-complete.name: Marukai
6442-complete.text: We could use more of your kind around here, $N. Thank you for your help.
6442-complete.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6442-progress.name: Marukai
6442-progress.text: The naga increase in numbers, $N. Please complete this task for me.
6442-progress.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6462-accept.name: Mitsuwa
6462-accept.text:
My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar!  Those vile Furbolgs!

I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife.  However, their troll charms hold great value in this world.  It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!

$N, you must retrieve the charms!  They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
6462-accept.title: Troll Charm

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

6561-accept.name: Unknown
6561-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $N, please.
6561-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6563-accept.name: Elymas
6563-accept.text:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
6563-accept.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-complete.text:
Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...

I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
6563-complete.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-accept.name: Unknown
6564-accept.text:
Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:

"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
6564-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-complete.text:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
6564-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-accept.text:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $N. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
6565-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald

6921-accept.name: Elymas
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-complete.text:
This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
6921-complete.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-accept.name: Unknown
6922-accept.text:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
6922-accept.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-complete.text:
This... this is quite the find, $N.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
6922-complete.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

843-accept.name: Gann Stonespire
843-accept.text:
In solitude I wander these roads.

The dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.

Attempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.

Drive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
843-accept.title: Gann's Reclamation

843-complete.name: Gann Stonespire
843-complete.text:
Khazgorm met the fate he earned. I feel no remorse for the fool. He was an infidel on these lands.

May his death serve as a warning to all those who threaten to disrupt our way of life.

Now let me take a moment to study the dwarf's journal....
843-complete.title: Gann's Reclamation

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

846-accept.name: Gann Stonespire
846-accept.text:
It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.

I want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.

Collect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
846-accept.title: Revenge of Gann

86614-progress.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-progress.text: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614-progress.title: Silver of the Waves

88-complete.name: Ma Stonefield
88-complete.text:
Thank goodness!  That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop!  Thank you, $N.

Now, do either of these suit you?
88-complete.title: Princess Must Die!

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

9-complete.name: Farmer Saldean
9-complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9-complete.title: The Killing Fields

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91751-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-complete.text: Excellent work collecting these pelts, $c. You have a real talent for hunting.
91751-complete.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91751-progress.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-progress.text: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
91751-progress.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

92-accept.name: Chef Breanna
92-accept.text:
Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.

Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-accept.title: Redridge Goulash

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92751-progress.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92751-progress.text: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
92751-progress.title: Detonation at a Distance

94229-accept.name: Unknown
94229-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Ornate Spyglass, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94229-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Ornate Spyglass

94819-accept.name: High Priestess Laurena
94819-accept.text: $N, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819-accept.title: Contingency Plan

94819-complete.name: High Priestess Mims
94819-complete.text:
Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great $c, $N. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!

You are ready for your next lesson in service.
94819-complete.title: Contingency Plan

97237-progress.name: Roy Lewells
97237-progress.text: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237-progress.title: Shelf Picked

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force
